task: If I ___ her number, I would call her right now. (know)
explanation shown to learner: An imagined present: *if* + past (*knew*), not *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta tagadne: *if* + pagātne (*knew*), nevis *would*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja es zinātu", *gribas would*, bet aiz *if* tā nav.

task: If the train ___ faster, more people would use it for work. (be)
explanation shown to learner: An imagined present: *if* + past (*knew*), not *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta tagadne: *if* + pagātne (*knew*), nevis *would*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja es zinātu", *gribas would*, bet aiz *if* tā nav.

task: I ___ more if the gym were closer to my office. (exercise)
explanation shown to learner: The result of an imagined present: *would* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomātas tagadnes *sekas*: *would* + pamatforma.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If we ___ earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight. (leave)
explanation shown to learner: An imagined past: *if* + *had* + 3rd form, not *would have*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta pagātne: *if + had* + 3. forma, nevis *would have*.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If you had asked me, I ___ you with the move. (help)
explanation shown to learner: The result in an imagined past: *would have* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: *Sekas* iedomātā pagātnē: *would have* + 3. forma.

task: Tom said he ___ the report the next day. (send)
explanation shown to learner: Reported later: *will* becomes *would*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstot vēlāk, *will* kļūst par *would*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "teica, ka nosūtīs", *gribas will*.

task: She told me she ___ in Riga for two years. (live)
correct answer: had lived | had been living | 'd lived | 'd been living
explanation shown to learner: Reported later: *has lived* becomes *had lived*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstot vēlāk, *has lived* kļūst par *had lived*.

task: The receptionist asked me where I ___ from. (be)
explanation shown to learner: A reported question: statement order and one step back in time: *where I was from*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstītā jautājumā: *apgalvojuma* secība un laiks soli atpakaļ: *where I was from*.

task: She asked me how long I ___ English. (study)
correct answer: had been studying | had studied | 'd been studying | 'd studied
explanation shown to learner: A reported question: one step back in time: *had been studying*.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstītā jautājumā laiks soli atpakaļ: *had been studying*.

topic: Indirect questions (Could you tell me where...)
task: Could you tell me what time the museum ___? (open)
explanation shown to learner: After *Could you tell me* the word order is like a statement, without *does*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz *Could you tell me* vārdu secība ir kā apgalvojumā, bez *does*.

topic: Narrative tenses with past perfect continuous
task: When I finally got through, I ___ on hold for forty minutes. (wait)
explanation shown to learner: How long something went on before a moment in the past: *had been* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: Cik ilgi kaut kas notika līdz kādam brīdim pagātnē: *had been + -ing*.

topic: Contrast, purpose and reason (although, despite, so that)
task: ___ the rain, we finished the hike.
explanation shown to learner: *Despite / In spite of* + noun (*the rain*); *although* needs subject + verb.
explanation in Latvian: *Despite / In spite of* + lietvārds (*the rain*); aiz *although* vajag teikuma priekšmetu un darbības vārdu.

topic: Contrast, purpose and reason (although, despite, so that)
task: She wrote everything down so as ___ anything. (not / forget)
explanation shown to learner: Purpose, negative: *so as not to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Nolūks noliegumā: *so as not to* + pamatforma.

topic: Contrast, purpose, reason and result (whereas, in case, therefore)
task: Take an umbrella in case it ___ later. (rain)
explanation shown to learner: After *in case* the present, not *will*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz *in case* tagadne, nevis *will*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja *nu* līs", *gribas will*.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: I would have gone to the concert if I ___ about it. (know)
explanation shown to learner: An imagined past: *if* + *had* + 3rd form, not *would have*.
explanation in Latvian: Iedomāta pagātne: *if + had* + 3. forma, nevis *would have*.

topic: Third conditional (if + had done, would have done)
task: If she hadn't checked the code, the app ___ . (crash)
explanation shown to learner: The result in an imagined past: *would have* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: *Sekas* iedomātā pagātnē: *would have* + 3. forma.

task: The doctor told me ___ anything heavy for a week. (not / lift)
explanation shown to learner: A reported instruction: *told me not to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: Atstāstīts norādījums: *told me not to* + pamatforma.

task: He apologised ___ late for the meeting. (be)
explanation shown to learner: *apologise for* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: *apologise for + -ing*.

task: My colleague suggested ___ a taxi to the airport. (take)
explanation shown to learner: *suggest* + *-ing* (or *suggest that we take*), never *suggest to*.
explanation in Latvian: *suggest + -ing* (vai *suggest that we take*), nekad *suggest to*. *Tulkojot burtiski "ieteica* paņemt", *gribas to take*.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: I'm not sure what time the meeting ___ . (start)
explanation shown to learner: Inside a sentence the question has statement order, without *does*.
explanation in Latvian: Teikuma iekšienē jautājumam ir *apgalvojuma* secība, bez *does*.

topic: Narrative tenses with past perfect continuous
task: Her eyes were red because she ___ . (cry)
explanation shown to learner: The result we see, from an activity before: *had been* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: *Redzams* rezultāts no agrākas darbības: *had been + -ing*.

task: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now. (be)
explanation shown to learner: A past choice with a result now: *would* + base form, because of *now*.
explanation in Latvian: Pagātnes izvēle ar sekām tagad: *would* + pamatforma, jo ir *now*.

task: If I ___ so shy, I would have spoken to her at the party. (not / be)
correct answer: weren't | wasn't | were not | was not
explanation shown to learner: A quality now (*so shy*) with a result in the past: *if* + past.
explanation in Latvian: Īpašība tagad (*so shy*) ar sekām pagātnē: *if* + pagātne.

topic: Contrast, purpose, reason and result (whereas, in case, therefore)
task: Sales fell sharply; ___ , the company cut its prices.
correct answer: therefore | as a result | consequently | thus
explanation shown to learner: A result as a new step after a semicolon: *therefore*, *as a result*.
explanation in Latvian: Rezultāts kā jauns *solis* aiz *semikola*: *therefore, as a result*.

task: If she ___ the job in London, she would be living there now. (accept)
explanation shown to learner: A past event with a result now: *if* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Pagātnes notikums ar sekām tagad: *if + had* + 3. forma.

task: I wish I ___ more time to travel this year. (have)
explanation shown to learner: A wish about now: *wish* + past.
explanation in Latvian: Vēlēšanās par tagadni: *wish* + pagātne. *Tulkojot burtiski* "es gribētu, lai man būtu", *gribas would have*.

task: I wish I ___ that comment in the meeting yesterday. (not / make)
explanation shown to learner: Regret about the past: *wish* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Nožēla par pagātni: *wish + had* + 3. forma.

task: We'll start at nine unless the speaker ___ late. (be)
explanation shown to learner: *unless* already means *if … not*: no second *not*.
explanation in Latvian: *unless* jau nozīmē *if* … *not*: otru noliegumu *neliek*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja *vien* nekavēsies", iznāk divi *noliegumi*.

task: ___ I known about the strike, I would have booked another flight. (have)
explanation shown to learner: Formal, without *if*: *Had I known*.
explanation in Latvian: Formāli, bez *if*: *Had I known.*

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: It's high time the government ___ something about housing. (do)
explanation shown to learner: *It's (high) time* + subject + past: it should already happen.
explanation in Latvian: *It's* (*high*) *time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne: tam jau vajadzētu *notikt*.

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: I'd rather you ___ my phone without asking. (not / use)
explanation shown to learner: *I'd rather* + another person + past.
explanation in Latvian: *I'd rather* + cits cilvēks + pagātne.

task: She insisted ___ for the whole dinner. (pay)
explanation shown to learner: *insist on* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: *insist on + -ing*.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: We couldn't decide where ___ on holiday. (go)
explanation shown to learner: Not knowing what to do: question word + *to* + base form.
explanation in Latvian: *Nezinot*, ko darīt: jautājamais vārds + to + pamatforma. *Tulkojot burtiski* "kur *mums braukt*", iznāk jautājuma secība.

task: ___ I in your position, I would ask for a pay rise. (be)
explanation shown to learner: Formal, without *if*: *Were I* (not *Was I*).
explanation in Latvian: Formāli, bez *if*: *Were I* (nevis *Was I*).

task: If it ___ for your advice, I would never have applied. (not / be)
explanation shown to learner: *If it hadn't been for* + noun = without it, in the past.
explanation in Latvian: *If it hadn't been for* + lietvārds = bez tā, pagātnē.

task: The minister denied ___ the report before it was published. (see)
explanation shown to learner: *deny* + *-ing* (or *having* + 3rd form).
explanation in Latvian: *deny + -ing* (vai *having* + 3. forma).

task: They accused the company ___ the data of its users. (sell)
explanation shown to learner: *accuse someone of* + *-ing*.
explanation in Latvian: *accuse someone of + -ing*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "apsūdzēja par", *gribas for*.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: ___ wins the competition will get a trip to Lisbon. (who)
explanation shown to learner: *Whoever* = it does not matter who: the person who.
explanation in Latvian: *Whoever* = nav svarīgi, kurš: tas, kurš.

topic: Indirect questions, more uses (I don't know what to do)
task: It depends on ___ the budget is approved.
explanation shown to learner: After a preposition use *whether*, not *if*.
explanation in Latvian: Aiz prievārda lieto *whether*, nevis *if*.

topic: Unreal time and preferences (it's high time, I'd rather)
task: It's about time you ___ to the dentist. (go)
explanation shown to learner: *It's about time* + subject + past.
explanation in Latvian: *It's about time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne.

task: If only I ___ my passport at home! (not / leave)
explanation shown to learner: Regret about the past: *If only* + *had* + 3rd form.
explanation in Latvian: Nožēla par pagātni: *If only + had* + 3. forma.
